post.summary: API to cancel specific exit reentry for specific resident
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to cancel issued valid exit re-entry Visa (single or multiple) for a resident under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to extend an exit re-entry visa for one of its resident.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to extend exit re-entry Visa (single or multiple) for residents currently are outside the kingdom under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to issue exit reentry
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to issue exit re-entry Visa (single or multiple) for a resident under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to re-print an exit re-entry visa for one of its resident.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to re-print exit re-entry Visa (single or multiple) for a resident under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to cancel an issued Final Exit Visa for a resident.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to cancel an issued Final Exit Visa for a resident (and dependents) under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to issue Final Exit Visa
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to issue Final Exit Visa for a resident (and dependents) under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to issue Final Exit Visa during the probationary period.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to issue Final Exit Visa during the probationary period for specific visitor (and dependents) under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to drop a resident with status (Left And Not Returned)
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to drop a resident with status (Left And Not Returned) for specific resident under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to issue Iqama
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to issue Iqama for specific visitor under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to issue a replacement iqama.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to issue a replacement iqama for specific resident under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to renew his resident's (and his dependents) Iqama.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to renew his resident's (and his dependents) Iqama, based on specific eligibility and validation checks.

post.summary: API to report a missing iqama
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to report a missing iqama for specific resident under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to transfer Iqama
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to transfer Iqama for specific resident to new employer under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to print or reprint Muqeem Report
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to print or reprint Muqeem Report for specific Resident under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to change occupation
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to change occupation for specific resident under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to check mol approval to change occupation
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to check mol approval for specific resident to change occupation under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to get active residents report.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to get a report of active residents. The withDepends flag determines whether to include dependent residents.

post.summary: API to inquire about Muqeem interactive services.
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to inquire about Muqeem interactive services.

post.summary: API to update a resident translated name

post.summary: API to print travel records report
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to print travel records Report for specific Resident or visitor under organization sponsorship

post.summary: API to Update Information (Change passport expiration date)
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to Update Information (Change passport expiration date) for a resident under their organization sponsorship.

post.summary: API to Update Information (Update passport information)
post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to Update Information (Update passport information) for a resident under my organization sponsorship.

post.description: This service allows Muqeem users to extend visit visa for for specific visitor and visa types under organization sponsorship
